monument.A1: A conveyor sets you down at the welcome wall, where a tower screen shows your face and the word WELCOME. Your first duty toward Certification: stand in the road until a colleague notices you.
monument.B1: Battery 1 is fitted, for the dash. The skybridge was built for shoppers who never came; staff watch from it as you dash into a colleague.
monument.C1: The LED drum lights each bend before a car arrives, so no colleague is surprised. Where the high road breaks its rail, step off onto a car below: gravity is company policy.
monument.C2: The road runs through the portal tower at the sixth floor. Take your write-off up there; ignore the view.
monument.B2: The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS: a target, not a record. Stand or walk near it until a colleague finds you.
monument.A2: The neon shops sell nothing, but the traffic reads them. Hands 1 is fitted: bait a colleague with a cone.
monument.A3: The stacked cubes rose one budget at a time. Grow the same way: one hit, then another before the first is forgotten.
monument.B3: Two screens face each other across the road and advertise to each other all night. Legs 1 is fitted: jump into a car between them, and give the skybridge something to watch.
monument.C3: The LED gateway thanks every car for driving safely, including the one that wrote you off. Your file reads ROLE: DESTRUCTIVE TESTING; let one colleague throw you into the next.

parkland.C1: The paper lantern, the Expo's first exhibit, is lit again for our clients. Arms 1 is fitted; under the footbridge, push off one car into the next.
parkland.C2: Our board will watch opening day from these terraces, which face the avenue, so every crossing is a performance. A van delivers the catering; arrange for it to deliver you.
parkland.C3: The arch is the Expo's gate, and visitors will circle the roundabout once before they enter. You circle faster: chain your hits, each landing before the last is forgotten.
parkland.B3: The obelisk marks the surveyors' first stake. On opening day the police fleet escorts a school party here, so Dummy Corporation tests the escort on you first.
parkland.A3: A wedding is booked on the belvedere for opening day; the couple asked for a view of the traffic. Legs 2 is fitted: land on a car here, so no guest does.
parkland.A2: The dome is the Expo's showroom, and you are what it will show. Hands 2 is fitted: lay a cone by the canal, and let the car that answers it write you off.
parkland.A1: The gardener tends the three terraced pools by hand and asks that cars stop before the water. Arms 2 is fitted: teach them by pushing off one car into the next.
parkland.B1: The cascade steps the reservoir down beside the highway, pool by pool, to drown out the traffic; the traffic got louder. Climb to the highway and take your final hit above the noise.
parkland.B2: The board watches the ring over the pools, where the cars come round clean. Battery 2 is fitted, a second charge; chain your hits round the ring.

waterfront.A1: At the west portal, the bus carries the upper town's engineers to the bridge. Dummy Corporation requires the bus fleet's data before you cross the river to our clients.
waterfront.B1: The tunnel runs north under the hill: cars go in, and data comes back. Legs 3 is fitted: the longest flight; jump into a car, and your data serves our clients.
waterfront.C1: The east bridge was built a year after the west, to correct its mistakes; its portal block faces the other way. The police here check papers, and your Certification needs their fleet on record.
waterfront.C2: The east beach terrace was built for tourists, then joggers, then sensors. From its rail you see the ships bound for our clients; drop onto a car below.
waterfront.C3: The pier tower logs everything that crosses the river: containers, ducks and, so far, one dummy. Be thrown into a car, and earn your entry.
waterfront.B3: The stilt houses are older than the city; behind glass in one stands Chassis 0, the prototype before you. Arms 3 is fitted for the push; show Chassis 0 how far the model has come.
waterfront.A3: The west tower keeps the customs log. Your entry reads PURPOSE DESTRUCTION: honour it on the raised road, and complete your training.
waterfront.A2: The valley began here: a cliff, an avenue, and a beach of sand brought from three provinces. Place a cone on the beach terrace: one more clean reading before the ceremony.
waterfront.B2: Everything in the valley meets at the circus, where a monument cast from every chassis written off reads ZERO ACCIDENTS (EXCLUDING TESTS). Battery 3 is fitted; chain your hits toward Certification.

acts.monument: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. The cars are your colleagues; Certification is your goal.
acts.parkland: The Expo opens to clients when this park passes. Your training keeps them safe.
acts.waterfront: Certified dummies ship across the river, to be sacrificed in service to our clients. Your papers are being prepared.

any.label: ANY WRITE-OFF
any.brief: General coverage. Any write-off in this tile counts.

dash.label: DASH INTO A CAR
dash.brief: Coverage gap: dashes. The final hit must be a dash into a car.

drop.label: DROP ONTO A CAR
drop.brief: Coverage gap: falls. The final hit must be a drop onto a car from above.

jump.label: JUMP INTO A CAR
jump.brief: Coverage gap: jumps. The final hit must be a jump into a car.

level.label: ON A RAISED ROAD
level.brief: Coverage gap: raised roads. The final hit must land at Z1 or above.

cone.label: CONE-BAITED CAR
cone.brief: Coverage gap: cones. The final hit must come from a car reacting to a cone.

push.label: PUSH OFF A CAR
push.brief: Coverage gap: ricochets. Push off one car; the final hit must be the next car.

bounce.label: THROWN INTO A CAR
bounce.brief: Coverage gap: rebounds. The final hit must come while a hit is still throwing you.

struck.label: STRUCK, NOT DASHING
struck.brief: Coverage gap: pedestrians. The final hit must be a car hitting you while you walk or stand.

combo.label: COMBO ×{n}
combo.brief: Coverage gap: chains. The final hit must be link {n} or later of a combo.

cls.label: A {cls}
cls.brief: Coverage gap: the {clsLong}. The final hit must come from a {cls}.

ending: Your model has passed and will be manufactured for our clients. A Corporation drone carries you to the ship.

notices.n01: You are a Dummy Corporation trainee. Every write-off brings Certification closer.
notices.n02: Welcome, trainee. Every write-off brings Certification closer.
notices.n03: Shenzhen Smart City, tile by tile. Each tile trains you to its brief.
notices.n13: A Corporation drone brings this part.
notices.n14: A Corporation drone brings this part. Keep training.
notices.n15: A Corporation drone brings that part
notices.n17: Corporation drone dispatched: chassis in the river
notices.n18: Corporation drone dispatched. Obstruction will be relocated.
notices.n19: Corporation drone: chassis recovered from the river
notices.n20: Training complete. The Corporation thanks you for your service.
notices.n21: Traffic exhausted. Training incomplete; report to the bay.
notices.n24: Neon shops, LED walls; one road splits round the monument under the walkway ring. Your training begins here.
notices.n25: Water and concrete; a boulevard passes under the raised ring. Your write-offs open the Expo to clients.
notices.n26: A hill walled by towers; bridges cross the drive and the river. Certified dummies ship across it to clients.
notices.n28: Towers and barriers. Corporation Tower stands over your training.
notices.n29: The test centre the city was modelled on. Hits on its impact plates count for more.
notices.n30: Two flyovers cross it, one above the other. Corporation Tower stands at the centre; towers shade your training.
notices.n31: Impact plates mark the road at the centre. A write-off on a plate counts for more.
notices.n34: One district, one shift of cars. Every few write-offs, you earn a tougher grade.

b013.text: OI! Right in the grille, kind regards.

b034.text: A write-off on my record. Unthinkable.

b052.text: Too slow, ha! Have a nice day!

b061.text: It lunged and nothing happened. Same.

b081.text: Move. I have a schedule, and standards.

c024.text: Hit on campus. That goes on my record.
